and he pleaded ignorance about the contents in it and has stated that the police have not seized anything in his presence.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-2 as hostile witness and cross examined him.

12. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that CW-1 being the complainant, key and material witness has not turned up before court to depose about the incident.
Despite issuance of summons to other chargesheeted witnesses, they failed to appear before court.

In the absence of evidence of material witnesses, this court holds that the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
